title: Detect Increase
text: Detect increase in signal value, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Initial condition} sets Initial condition of previous input; {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial condition
params.values: Initial condition of previous input 0.0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Specify sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)
